prompts.left:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a whole-character animated game sprite sheet.
INPUT 1 is the exact character identity, armor and held rifle AND the required orientation: face, chest, both knees and rifle all point SCREEN LEFT in a FRONT-LEFT three-quarter view.
INPUT 2 shows six chronological walking poses of the approved heavy Bastion. It is a MOTION and camera reference only. Do not copy its orange armor, large build, fists or helmet.
Draw the woman from INPUT 1 in EXACTLY those six compact walking phases, with her rifle held in both hands. Preserve her bun, face, navy clothing, asymmetrical silver plates, body proportions and rifle identity. Preserve this FRONT-LEFT angle in ALL six poses. The rifle muzzle points LEFT in every cell, the stock sits to the RIGHT at her shoulder. Do not reverse this.
Sheet: THREE columns and TWO rows, six equal square cells, chronological phases 0,1,2 on the top row and 3,4,5 on the bottom row. BOTH rows face LEFT; they are the two halves of ONE walk cycle, NOT different directions. Each cell is a complete separately drawn coherent full figure. Clear alpha gutters between figures. 1536x1024 transparent canvas, cells512square, body height416, sole baseline472 in each cell.
Movement: copy INPUT2's restrained forward walking, feet move in depth along the facing direction, feet remain near the centerline, narrow compact steps, no wide planted stance, no splits, no sidestepping or running. Alternate supporting foot, lift the passing heel slightly, minimal bob. The first three poses make one step, the last three the next step. Rifle stays rigid and stable with two connected arms, two proper hands at the grip and fore-end, complete sleeves and shoulders. Identical rifle length and straight barrel in every frame.
Same illustrated game sprite style and controlled dark contours as INPUT1, crisp at native64. No added effects, shadows, ground, text, border or background. No pasted leg replacements, no deformation of a standing image, no rear view. All six figures must visibly face LEFT.
prompts.right:
Use case: identity-preserve, transparent whole-character game walk sprite atlas.
Reference1: exact woman identity/outfit/rifle, front-RIGHT three quarter angle. Reference2: EXACT six walk poses/camera from the approved heavy Bastion, arranged3columns2rows.
Replace the orange Bastion in each of the SIX poses in reference2 with the woman in reference1, retaining her slim proportions, hairstyle, facial identity, navy suit and asymmetric silver plates. Add her actual held rifle in both hands with stable grips. Her face, torso and rifle point RIGHT throughout; muzzle to the RIGHT, rifle stock LEFT against shoulder. Preserve armor's different left/right arms. Both rows of this sheet face the SAME RIGHT direction, because these six poses are a single chronological cycle.
Follow reference2 for the LOWER BODY GAIT of each pose exactly, preserving woman's slim proportions. Six DISTINCT stances: (0) near leg supporting ahead, far heel behind; (1) far knee passes supporting near leg; (2) far boot reaches forward; (3) far leg now supports ahead, near heel behind; (4) near knee passes supporting far leg; (5) near boot reaches forward. Pose3 must exchange the supporting leg from pose0. Feet stay close to the centerline, modest forward steps, no sideways wide stance or splits. Minimal head bob, whole coherent figure redrawn for every frame, no grafted legs. No hop or running.
Exactly3columns2rows, full figure each cell, equal square cells512 with clear transparent gutters. Output1536x1024. Same camera and scale, sole baseline472 percell, height416. Full boots/head/weapon inside cells. Preserve rifle rigid straight same length, complete connected shoulders/arms/wrists/hands, both hands meet rifle. Existing illustrated matte style and restrained dark contours from reference1, no stylistic redesign.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no black background, no glow, no drop shadow, no colored halo, no floor. No text, borders or labels. Clean alpha immediately outside character silhouette. ALL6 FIGURES FACE SCREEN RIGHT, front threequarters; no back view.
